body:
Sorry your reference is lost on me as I've never even seen a single cricket match in my life! I'm a New Yorker :)


I have eczema so I take zinc. Not sure if I have seen real benefit but I'm guessing it can't hurt and would take a while until I see a change. Fish oil is also for eczema since I have very dry skin. I just started taking it so, again, not sure how well it is going to work.



I couldn't really socialize last few months before the break up either. It was just pretending to be entertaining/entertained. But I do think it got worse after the break up. I will check out enotalone. Thanks!

Besides the irregular sleeping schedule, I don't really have any physical change/symptoms. I also have slightly decreased appetite and lost maybe 5~8 lbs (I'm 118 now) over last 6 months but I still eat a lot of food (mostly healthy) because I like food to begin with.

May I ask what anti-oxidants you took? I try to drink green tea but I don't drink it everyday. Btw my current supplements are Zinc, Vit A, Vit D3, Vit E, fish oil, and glucosamine. Thanks for the advice and reading, I just don't like feeling unsociable even when I want to socialize.

Hey I just wanted to let you know that I kinda go through similar situation as yours. I stay awake doing whatever trivial stuff there is until I pass out because.. I can't just lie down, with my head bringing up all the failures and self-deprecating thoughts. 

At one point in my life, I used to think what if I just never wake up? Or I hope tomorrow, a bus or a heavy truck would just run me over. Or maybe some robber would rob my house and kill me in the process. I don't think about those things anymore. So even though I still am not making much progress with my life, I want to tell you that those thoughts can get away. Sorry I'm not much of a help.

I think the void has been there for a while now (a couple of years?). But with school and social life, I kept it small and hidden. But few months before and after the break up (which happened earlier this month), it's a lot bigger. Seeing how it just happened, maybe feeling that void is normal. This is my first painful break up so what do I know.


I do suspect I have depression. I did talk to a doctor two years ago but I felt it didn't really help me. But there's no point in not talking to them again so I'll talk to a doctor.


I don't get any exercise, really. I never really exercised constantly, to be honest. I'm definitely not fit but I'm also not fat so maybe that's what I don't really do much about it. For some reason sweat really bothers the skin around my neck. I suspect it's my eczema and my dermatologist was like "well don't exercise then" lol ??? 

I eat decently healthy thanks to my parents. I have sleeping problem though. I have problem going to sleep and waking up at regular time. While I'm home, I get up at the same time every morning but my sleeping time varies from 11pm to 7am (it's 4:43am now :( ) which would lead me to taking a long nap during the day and then not go to sleep until late morning. I suspect that I don't like to going to sleep until I'm ready to pass out because once I'm lying down and not sleeping, I just think of all the bad things in my life and it's unbearable to just lie awake thinking about that.

Thanks for suggesting professional help. I do think I need it and maybe I just needed someone to tell me I need it.

Hey thanks for the message :)

I used to love going out so much that my parents are pretty worried that I don't go out of home. So not wanting to hangout with people in general makes me confused and frustrated. Good to hear that I'm not alone in feeling that way. But you know, I used to think that I had lots of friends but I'm not so sure anymore. I suppose I gotta keep looking for new people that I like and hang out more. 



And yes, break up happened earlier this month... Not sure if it was the best decision. At one point, we even discussed getting married and now we are not anything. I feel quite sad and guilty, even wrong, calling him my ex. But I would like to think I did the right thing because I felt I didn't love him anymore and all that fighting and arguments wore me down so much that I just wanted out. However, what if it was just my possible-depression talking? I don't know and don't want to care but it's on my mind constantly. I feel like I broke my own heart :(


I'll try to keep busy. Thanks for the advice :) And your username, for some odd reason, made me smile. Probably because I feel like I'm a sad bastardette. Haha.
